<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<style>
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;width:240px;height:294px}
canvas{display:block;position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:240px;height:294px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const W = 240, H = 294;
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(W, H, false);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();

// ---------- background (procedural 64x64 gradient) ----------
const bc = document.createElement('canvas'); bc.width = 64; bc.height = 64;
const g2 = bc.getContext('2d');
const lg = g2.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 64);
lg.addColorStop(0, '#ece49a'); lg.addColorStop(0.25, '#f8f4cc'); lg.addColorStop(0.45, '#ffffff');
lg.addColorStop(0.65, '#fffdf0'); lg.addColorStop(0.85, '#f4e9a0'); lg.addColorStop(1, '#e9d670');
g2.fillStyle = lg; g2.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
const rg = g2.createRadialGradient(32, 30, 2, 32, 30, 40);
rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)'); rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
g2.fillStyle = rg; g2.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
const bgTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(bc); bgTex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
scene.background = bgTex;

// ---------- camera ----------
const CAM_D = 23.3;
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(20, W / H, 0.1, 200);
camera.position.set(0.47, 5.0, CAM_D);
camera.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);

// ---------- lights ----------
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 1.1));
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xf0dc90, 1.0));
const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff8e8, 1.7); key.position.set(3, 8, 12); scene.add(key);
const back = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff0c0, 1.1); back.position.set(-4, 7, -10); scene.add(back);
const sideL = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.5); sideL.position.set(-10, 4, 2); scene.add(sideL);

// ---------- materials ----------
const BODY = 0xe8bf1e;
const matBody = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: BODY, roughness: 0.78 });
const matVC = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.78 });
const matDark = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4d4a24, roughness: 0.8 });
const matEye = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2e2a1c, roughness: 0.7 });
const matRing = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x93b548, roughness: 0.7 });
const matBeak = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf0b274, roughness: 0.7 });
const matMouth = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xb8705c, roughness: 0.8 });
const matSmile = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6b4424, roughness: 0.8 });

const sstep = (a, b, x) => { const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a))); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
const lerp = (a, b, w) => a + (b - a) * w;
const tmp = new THREE.Color(), tmp2 = new THREE.Color();
const cBody = new THREE.Color(BODY), cPeach = new THREE.Color(0xf6c6a6),
  cPinkB = new THREE.Color(0xf2b2ac), cWhite = new THREE.Color(0xfff6e2);
function band(v, out) {
  out.copy(cPinkB).lerp(cPeach, sstep(-0.2, 0.3, v));
  out.lerp(cWhite, Math.exp(-Math.pow((v - 0.08) / 0.26, 2)));
  return out;
}

// ---------- helpers ----------
function seg(len, r0, r1, mat) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  const c = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r0, r1, len, 18, 1, true), mat);
  c.position.y = -len / 2; g.add(c);
  g.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r0, 18, 12), mat));
  const s1 = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r1, 18, 12), mat); s1.position.y = -len; g.add(s1);
  return g;
}

// ---------- character ----------
const penguin = new THREE.Group(); penguin.name = 'character-penguin';
scene.add(penguin);

const torso = new THREE.Group(); torso.name = 'torso'; torso.position.set(0, 3.4, 0);
penguin.add(torso);
const up = new THREE.Group(); up.name = 'torso-offset'; up.position.y = -3.4; torso.add(up);

// torso (lathe) with belly patch painted on
const prof = [[0, 2.95], [0.55, 3.0], [1.0, 3.17], [1.3, 3.5], [1.52, 3.95], [1.64, 4.5], [1.66, 5.0],
  [1.58, 5.6], [1.38, 6.2], [1.08, 6.7], [0.85, 7.0], [0.7, 7.25], [0.55, 7.45], [0, 7.55]];
const curve = new THREE.SplineCurve(prof.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])));
const lp = curve.getPoints(60).map(p => new THREE.Vector2(Math.max(0, p.x), p.y));
lp[0].x = 0; lp[lp.length - 1].x = 0;
const bodyG = new THREE.Group(); bodyG.name = 'body'; up.add(bodyG);
const tGeo = new THREE.LatheGeometry(lp, 64);
{
  const p = tGeo.attributes.position, col = new Float32Array(p.count * 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    const x = p.getX(i), y = p.getY(i), z = p.getZ(i);
    const v = (y - 4.72) / 1.78, uu = x / 1.38, d = Math.sqrt(uu * uu + v * v);
    const wgt = z > 0 ? 1 - sstep(0.8, 1.0, d) : 0;
    band(v, tmp); tmp2.copy(cBody).lerp(tmp, wgt);
    col[i * 3] = tmp2.r; col[i * 3 + 1] = tmp2.g; col[i * 3 + 2] = tmp2.b;
  }
  tGeo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(col, 3));
}
const torsoMesh = new THREE.Mesh(tGeo, matVC);
torsoMesh.name = 'torso-mesh'; torsoMesh.scale.z = 0.95; bodyG.add(torsoMesh);

// belly bulge
const bGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 40, 30);
{
  const p = bGeo.attributes.position, col = new Float32Array(p.count * 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    const x = p.getX(i), y = p.getY(i), z = p.getZ(i);
    const d = Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
    band(y, tmp);
    tmp.lerp(cBody, z < 0 ? 1 : sstep(0.78, 0.98, d));
    col[i * 3] = tmp.r; col[i * 3 + 1] = tmp.g; col[i * 3 + 2] = tmp.b;
  }
  bGeo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(col, 3));
}
const belly = new THREE.Mesh(bGeo, matVC); belly.name = 'belly';
bodyG.add(belly);

// ---------- head ----------
const hr = { x: 0.72, y: 0.86, z: 0.76 };
function headSurf(x, y) {
  const t = y / hr.y, f = 1 - 0.15 * t, s = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - t * t));
  const ax = hr.x * f * s, az = hr.z * f * s;
  const q = ax > 1e-5 ? x / ax : 0;
  return az * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - q * q));
}
function surfNormal(x, y) {
  const e = 0.01;
  const dx = (headSurf(x + e, y) - headSurf(x - e, y)) / (2 * e);
  const dy = (headSurf(x, y + e) - headSurf(x, y - e)) / (2 * e);
  return new THREE.Vector3(-dx, -dy, 1).normalize();
}
const hGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 40, 28);
{
  const p = hGeo.attributes.position, col = new Float32Array(p.count * 3);
  const cTop = new THREE.Color(0xd3cf44), cBase = new THREE.Color(0xe8c426), cPink = new THREE.Color(0xf2a394);
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    const x = p.getX(i), y = p.getY(i), z = p.getZ(i), f = 1 - 0.15 * y;
    tmp.copy(cBase).lerp(cTop, sstep(-0.2, 0.8, y));
    const w = sstep(0.25, 0.75, z) * sstep(-0.8, -0.4, y) * (1 - sstep(0.0, 0.32, y));
    tmp.lerp(cPink, w * 0.9);
    col[i * 3] = tmp.r; col[i * 3 + 1] = tmp.g; col[i * 3 + 2] = tmp.b;
    p.setXYZ(i, x * f * hr.x, y * hr.y, z * f * hr.z);
  }
  hGeo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(col, 3));
  hGeo.computeVertexNormals();
}
const head = new THREE.Group(); head.name = 'head'; head.position.set(0, 7.12, 0);
head.rotation.order = 'YXZ'; up.add(head);
const skull = new THREE.Group(); skull.name = 'head-center'; skull.position.y = 0.63; head.add(skull);
const headMesh = new THREE.Mesh(hGeo, matVC); headMesh.name = 'head-mesh'; skull.add(headMesh);

function surfLine(cx, cy, halfW, fn, r, mat) {
  const c = new THREE.Vector3(cx, cy, headSurf(cx, cy));
  const pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
    const u = i / 4 - 1, x = cx + u * halfW, y = cy + fn(u);
    pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, headSurf(x, y) + 0.004).sub(c));
  }
  const grp = new THREE.Group(); grp.position.copy(c);
  grp.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts), 24, r, 8, false), mat));
  for (const e of [pts[0], pts[8]]) {
    const s = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r, 8, 6), mat); s.position.copy(e); grp.add(s);
  }
  return grp;
}

// eyes: closed arc + open eye (ring + pupil)
const eyes = new THREE.Group(); eyes.name = 'eyes'; skull.add(eyes);
function makeEye(sx, name) {
  const g = new THREE.Group(); g.name = 'eye-' + name;
  const closed = surfLine(sx * 0.27, 0.3, 0.17, u => -0.045 * u * u - sx * 0.02 * u, 0.024, matEye);
  closed.name = 'eye-closed-' + name;
  const ex = sx * 0.34, ey = 0.32;
  const open = new THREE.Group(); open.name = 'eye-open-' + name;
  open.position.set(ex, ey, headSurf(ex, ey));
  open.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), surfNormal(ex, ey));
  const lid = new THREE.Group(); lid.name = 'eye-ball-' + name;
  const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 12), matRing); ring.scale.set(0.15, 0.15, 0.035);
  const pupil = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 12), matEye); pupil.scale.set(0.1, 0.1, 0.045);
  pupil.position.z = 0.012;
  lid.add(ring, pupil); open.add(lid);
  g.add(closed, open); eyes.add(g);
  return { closed, open, lid };
}
const eyeL = makeEye(1, 'left'), eyeR = makeEye(-1, 'right');

const beak = new THREE.Group(); beak.name = 'beak';
beak.position.set(0, -0.02, headSurf(0, -0.02) - 0.03);
const bm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 12), matBeak); bm.scale.set(0.12, 0.07, 0.12);
beak.add(bm); skull.add(beak);

const mouth = new THREE.Group(); mouth.name = 'mouth'; skull.add(mouth);
const mouths = [];
for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
  const p = j / 4;
  const m = surfLine(0, -0.22 + 0.11 * p, 0.1 + 0.15 * p, u => (0.025 + 0.06 * p) * u * u,
    0.012 + 0.007 * p, p < 0.4 ? matMouth : matSmile);
  m.name = 'mouth-shape-' + j; m.visible = j === 0; mouth.add(m); mouths.push(m);
}

// ---------- arms & hands ----------
const L1 = 1.5, L2 = 1.05, SH_X = 1.2, SH_Y = 6.25;
function makeHand(side, name) {
  const h = new THREE.Group(); h.name = 'hand-' + name;
  const palm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 12), matDark);
  palm.scale.set(0.16, 0.24, 0.08); palm.position.y = -0.2; h.add(palm);
  const fingers = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const f = new THREE.Group(); f.name = 'finger-' + name + '-' + i;
    f.position.set((i - 1.5) * 0.075, -0.36, 0); f.rotation.z = (i - 1.5) * 0.16;
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.036, 0.4, 4, 8), matDark); m.position.y = -0.2;
    f.add(m); h.add(f); fingers.push(f);
  }
  const th = new THREE.Group(); th.name = 'thumb-' + name;
  th.position.set(-side * 0.13, -0.14, 0.02); th.rotation.z = -side * 0.6;
  const tm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.038, 0.24, 4, 8), matDark); tm.position.y = -0.12;
  th.add(tm); h.add(th);
  return { g: h, fingers };
}
function makeArm(side, name) {
  const g = new THREE.Group(); g.name = 'arm-' + name; g.position.set(side * SH_X, SH_Y, 0);
  const upper = seg(L1, 0.24, 0.17, matBody); upper.name = 'upperarm-' + name; g.add(upper);
  const fore = new THREE.Group(); fore.name = 'forearm-' + name;
  fore.add(seg(L2, 0.17, 0.11, matBody));
  const hand = makeHand(side, name); hand.g.position.y = -L2; fore.add(hand.g);
  g.add(fore); up.add(g);
  return { side, g, upper, fore, hand: hand.g, fingers: hand.fingers };
}
const armL = makeArm(1, 'left'), armR = makeArm(-1, 'right');

// two-bone IK (shoulder-relative results)
const _d = new THREE.Vector3(), _dir = new THREE.Vector3(), _perp = new THREE.Vector3();
const sol = { E: new THREE.Vector3(), W: new THREE.Vector3(), u: new THREE.Vector3(), f: new THREE.Vector3() };
function solveArm(side, T, pole, out) {
  _d.set(T.x - side * SH_X, T.y - SH_Y, T.z);
  let d = _d.length();
  if (d < 1e-5) { _d.set(0, -1, 0); d = 1e-5; }
  _dir.copy(_d).normalize();
  const dc = Math.min(Math.max(d, 0.5), L1 + L2 - 0.012);
  const a = (L1 * L1 - L2 * L2 + dc * dc) / (2 * dc);
  const h = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, L1 * L1 - a * a));
  _perp.copy(pole).addScaledVector(_dir, -pole.dot(_dir));
  if (_perp.lengthSq() < 1e-8) { _perp.set(side, -0.3, 0.1); _perp.addScaledVector(_dir, -_perp.dot(_dir)); }
  _perp.normalize();
  out.E.copy(_dir).multiplyScalar(a).addScaledVector(_perp, h);
  out.W.copy(_dir).multiplyScalar(dc);
  out.u.copy(out.E).normalize();
  out.f.copy(out.W).sub(out.E).normalize();
  return out;
}

// ---------- legs ----------
function makeLeg(side, name) {
  const leg = new THREE.Group(); leg.name = 'leg-' + name; leg.position.set(side * 0.62, 3.4, 0);
  const thigh = seg(1.65, 0.52, 0.36, matBody); thigh.name = 'thigh-' + name; leg.add(thigh);
  const shin = new THREE.Group(); shin.name = 'shin-' + name; shin.position.y = -1.65;
  shin.add(seg(1.5, 0.36, 0.2, matBody));
  const foot = new THREE.Group(); foot.name = 'foot-' + name; foot.position.y = -1.5;
  const fm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 14), matDark);
  fm.scale.set(0.3, 0.16, 0.52); fm.position.set(0, -0.09, 0.28); foot.add(fm);
  shin.add(foot); leg.add(shin); penguin.add(leg);
  return { g: leg, shin, foot };
}
const legL = makeLeg(1, 'left'), legR = makeLeg(-1, 'right');

// ---------- ground ----------
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(3, 48),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf6eeb8, roughness: 1 }));
ground.name = 'ground'; ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; scene.add(ground);

// ---------- keyframes ----------
const P = 5540;
const KT = [0, 800, 1530, 2330, 3130, 3930, 4670, 5470];
const keyDefaults = { rotY: 0, leanX: 0, leanZ: 0, hYaw: 0, hPitch: 0, hRoll: 0, b: 0, q: 1, smile: 0,
  swL: 0, swR: 0, kbL: 0, kbR: 0, knee: 0 };
const A_ = (T, pole, hint, hx = 0, hz = 0, sp = 0.16, wv = 0) => ({ T, pole, hint, hx, hz, sp, wv });
const keys = [
  // 0 ms: standing, eyes closed, arms at sides
  { cam: [0.47, 5.0, 1.0], b: 0.6,
    aL: A_([1.75, 3.845, 0.11], [1, 0.2, -0.2], [0, 0, 1]),
    aR: A_([-1.776, 3.857, 0.11], [-1, 0.2, -0.2], [0, 0, 1]) },
  // 800 ms: turned, both hands at the mouth
  { cam: [1.55, 5.41, 0.9], rotY: 0.6, leanX: 0.05, leanZ: -0.04, hYaw: -0.35, hPitch: 0.1, b: 0.2, smile: 0.5, knee: 0.08,
    aL: A_([0.3, 7.15, 1.2], [0.6, -1, 0], [0, 0, 1], 0, 0, 0.1),
    aR: A_([-0.5, 7.15, 1.15], [-0.6, -1, 0], [0, 0, 1], 0, 0, 0.1) },
  // 1530 ms: both hands up, waving, smiling
  { cam: [0.6, 5.2, 0.93], hRoll: 0.04, b: 0, smile: 1,
    aL: A_([1.95, 5.7, 1.4], [-1, 0, 0.5], [0, 0, -1], 0, -0.35, 0.3, 0.25),
    aR: A_([-1.45, 6.15, 1.1], [-0.3, -1, 0], [0, 0, -1], 0, -0.3, 0.3, 0.25) },
  // 2330 ms: close-up, belly thrust
  { cam: [0.2, 5.1, 1.36], leanX: -0.12, hPitch: 0.1, b: 1, q: 1.05, smile: 0.25,
    aL: A_([2.05, 4.4, -0.1], [0.3, 0, -1], [0, 0, 1]),
    aR: A_([-2.0, 4.45, -0.1], [-0.3, 0, -1], [0, 0, 1]) },
  // 3130 ms: right hand waving in front of chest
  { cam: [0.175, 5.39, 1.12], leanZ: 0.02, b: 0.6, smile: 1,
    aL: A_([1.45, 4.0, 0.8], [1, 0.2, -0.2], [0, 0, 1]),
    aR: A_([-0.65, 6.0, 1.6], [-1, -0.8, 0], [0, 0, -1], 0, -0.6, 0.3, 0.3) },
  // 3930 ms: turned to the side, arms reaching forward
  { cam: [0.22, 5.0, 1.0], rotY: -1.75, b: 0.3, q: 0.92, smile: 0.5,
    aL: A_([1.3, 6.6, 2.1], [0.3, -1, 0], [0, 1, -0.3], 0.6, 0, 0.25),
    aR: A_([-1.0, 7.6, 2.1], [-0.3, -1, 0], [0, 1, -0.3], -0.8, 0, 0.3) },
  // 4670 ms: turned further, leaning forward, stride
  { cam: [-0.35, 4.8, 1.0], rotY: -1.95, leanX: 0.12, b: 0.3, q: 0.92, smile: 0.5,
    swL: 0.35, swR: -0.1, kbL: 0.05, kbR: 0.25,
    aL: A_([1.3, 6.6, 2.1], [0.3, -1, 0], [0, 1, -0.3], 0.6, 0, 0.25),
    aR: A_([-0.9, 7.25, 2.3], [-0.3, -1, 0], [0, 1, -0.3], -0.8, 0, 0.3) },
  // 5470 ms: side view, belly in, arms hanging back
  { cam: [0.235, 5.75, 0.95], rotY: -1.3, leanX: 0.14, b: -0.2, q: 0.75, smile: 0.3,
    aL: A_([1.35, 3.95, -0.7], [0.5, 0, -1], [0, 0, 1]),
    aR: A_([-1.35, 3.95, -0.5], [-0.5, 0, -1], [0, 0, 1]) }
].map(k => Object.assign({}, keyDefaults, k));

const DOWN = new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0);
const _x = new THREE.Vector3(), _y = new THREE.Vector3(), _z = new THREE.Vector3(), _m = new THREE.Matrix4();
for (const k of keys) {
  for (const pr of [['aL', 1], ['aR', -1]]) {
    const a = k[pr[0]], side = pr[1];
    a.Tv = new THREE.Vector3(a.T[0], a.T[1], a.T[2]);
    a.poleV = new THREE.Vector3(a.pole[0], a.pole[1], a.pole[2]);
    a.r = Math.hypot(a.T[0], a.T[2]);
    a.phi = Math.atan2(a.T[2], side * a.T[0]);
    a.y = a.T[1];
    solveArm(side, a.Tv, a.poleV, sol);
    const hint = new THREE.Vector3(a.hint[0], a.hint[1], a.hint[2]);
    _y.copy(sol.f).negate();
    _z.copy(hint).addScaledVector(sol.f, -hint.dot(sol.f));
    if (_z.lengthSq() < 1e-8) _z.set(0, 0, 1);
    _z.normalize();
    _x.crossVectors(_y, _z);
    a.qF = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(_m.makeBasis(_x, _y, _z));
  }
}

const _T = new THREE.Vector3(), _pole = new THREE.Vector3(), _cur = new THREE.Vector3();
const _qs = new THREE.Quaternion(), _qc = new THREE.Quaternion();
function poseArm(arm, a, b, u, w, wave) {
  const dist = a.Tv.distanceTo(b.Tv);
  const bulge = 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u) * Math.min(1, dist / 1.5);
  const r = lerp(a.r, b.r, w) + bulge, phi = lerp(a.phi, b.phi, w), y = lerp(a.y, b.y, w);
  const amp = lerp(a.wv, b.wv, w);
  _T.set(arm.side * r * Math.cos(phi) + 0.45 * amp * wave, y, r * Math.sin(phi));
  _pole.copy(a.poleV).lerp(b.poleV, w);
  solveArm(arm.side, _T, _pole, sol);
  arm.upper.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(DOWN, sol.u);
  arm.fore.position.copy(sol.E);
  _qs.slerpQuaternions(a.qF, b.qF, w);
  _cur.set(0, -1, 0).applyQuaternion(_qs).normalize();
  _qc.setFromUnitVectors(_cur, sol.f);
  arm.fore.quaternion.multiplyQuaternions(_qc, _qs);
  arm.hand.rotation.set(lerp(a.hx, b.hx, w), 0, lerp(a.hz, b.hz, w) + amp * wave);
  const sp = lerp(a.sp, b.sp, w);
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) arm.fingers[i].rotation.z = (i - 1.5) * sp;
}

function pose(t) {
  const tt = ((t % P) + P) % P;
  let i = 7;
  for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) { if (tt < KT[k + 1]) { i = k; break; } }
  let u = 0, w = 0;
  if (i < 7) { u = (tt - KT[i]) / (KT[i + 1] - KT[i]); w = u * u * (3 - 2 * u); }
  const A = keys[i], B = keys[(i + 1) % 8];
  const S = n => A[n] + (B[n] - A[n]) * w;
  const live = i < 7 ? 1 : 0;
  const s2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * u);
  const bounce = live * 0.5 * (1 - Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * u));
  const sway = live * s2;
  const wave = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * (tt - 1530) / 400);

  // camera: truck + dolly only, always looking down -Z
  camera.position.set(lerp(A.cam[0], B.cam[0], w), lerp(A.cam[1], B.cam[1], w), CAM_D / lerp(A.cam[2], B.cam[2], w));
  camera.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);

  penguin.rotation.y = S('rotY');

  // legs + hip height
  const stepAmp = live * 0.4 * Math.min(1, Math.abs(B.rotY - A.rotY) / 1.0 + Math.abs(B.cam[2] - A.cam[2]) / 0.35);
  const a = S('knee') + 0.2 * bounce;
  const kn = a + Math.asin(Math.min(1, 1.1 * Math.sin(a)));
  const liftL = stepAmp * Math.max(0, s2), liftR = stepAmp * Math.max(0, -s2);
  const AL = S('swL') + a + liftL, kL = S('kbL') + kn + 2 * liftL;
  const AR = S('swR') + a + liftR, kR = S('kbR') + kn + 2 * liftR;
  const reachL = 1.65 * Math.cos(AL) + 1.5 * Math.cos(kL - AL);
  const reachR = 1.65 * Math.cos(AR) + 1.5 * Math.cos(kR - AR);
  const hipY = 0.25 + Math.max(reachL, reachR);
  legL.g.position.y = hipY; legL.g.rotation.x = -AL; legL.shin.rotation.x = kL; legL.foot.rotation.x = AL - kL;
  legR.g.position.y = hipY; legR.g.rotation.x = -AR; legR.shin.rotation.x = kR; legR.foot.rotation.x = AR - kR;

  // torso + head
  torso.position.y = hipY;
  torso.rotation.set(S('leanX'), 0, S('leanZ') + 0.03 * sway);
  head.rotation.set(S('hPitch'), S('hYaw'), S('hRoll') - 0.04 * sway);

  // belly
  const b = S('b');
  belly.scale.set(1.22 + 0.42 * b, 1.62 + 0.33 * b, 1.15 + 0.3 * b);
  belly.position.set(0, 4.75 - 0.05 * b, 0.45 + 0.28 * b);
  bodyG.scale.z = S('q');

  // eyes
  const eo = sstep(80, 300, tt);
  for (const e of [eyeL, eyeR]) {
    e.open.visible = eo > 0.03;
    e.lid.scale.y = Math.max(0.05, eo);
    e.closed.visible = eo < 0.5;
  }

  // mouth
  const sm = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, S('smile')));
  const idx = Math.round(sm * 4);
  for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) mouths[j].visible = j === idx;
  beak.scale.setScalar(1 - 0.5 * sm);

  // arms
  poseArm(armL, A.aL, B.aL, u, w, wave);
  poseArm(armR, A.aR, B.aR, u, w, wave);
}

// ---------- harness ----------
function render(t) {
  pose(Number.isFinite(t) ? t : 0);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref: camera }, characters: [penguin], render, ready: true };
</script>
</body>
</html>
